blocker.message: The private-file journal service requires POSIX file ownership and permissions and is unavailable on Windows.

remediation.instruction: On Windows, use the local journal in an ordinary Node browser host without operations.journalService. The private-file journal service requires a POSIX host. Preserve any existing operation identity.
remediation.label: Use a supported journal host
